mentions.name: Hello Terrain
mentions.description: This library provides large open-world terrain rendering for three.js's WebGPU renderer. It is built on quadtrees and supports arbitrary topologies, demonstrated with planet and donut-world demos (torus, cube-sphere) plus a raycast character controller example.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a large open-world terrain-rendering library for threejs's webgpu renderer! https://hello-terrain.kenny.wtf/

At its core, it uses quadtrees, and has affordances for arbitrary topologies. Check out the planet and donut-world demos!!!!
